meta.title: Deriv Inverse 1 V1
meta.prompt: Each equation on the left gives the tangent line to a graph \(y=f(x)\) at some point \((a,b)\). For some of these, the equation of the tangent line to \(y=f^{-1}(x)\) at the point \((b,a)\) is given on the right. Match the equations on the left to the corresponding equations on the right, when applicable.
